name: Module 1b: cell prep
source: PLACEHOLDER, after the sheet's cell-prep rows (contracts/sources/chip_geometry_requirements.xlsx): quench, wash, 30 um filter (10x / inDrops / TIP-seq), viability >= 90% (10x), resuspend in the viscous resuspension buffer (SPC-NAR) at ~0.1 cells per capsule (SPC-NAR / CapSeq). Volumes, flows and times are placeholders; the cell-wash method is TBC.
description: Take the three Module 1 lanes already merged at one inlet, quench, wash, filter, count, resuspend at the concentration Module 2 needs (the operator sets the dilution from the count), and send the cells to Module 2's core inlet once the safety checker approves. The chip has no valves: routing is the step's ports (feed, vent, cap) plus off-chip selector valves.

steps.note: Cells arrive at m1b_cells_in_1 from Module 1's one outlet m1_out_1, already merged (labelled per chamber in Module 1, so they share one line), and fill half of the quench serpentine m1b_mix_1; m1b_waste_1 is vented.
Quench: m1b_quench_in_1 (off-chip selector valve on quench medium) joins the cells at the T-junction and the serpentine mixes it in, neutralising the detach reagent.
Wash the cells into clean buffer fed at m1b_wash_in_1; the old liquid leaves through the vented m1b_waste_1. (Method TBC: DLD array, spiral channel or density cushion.)

Through the depth-weir filter (a 27 um gap under the crest) to the QC window: clumps stay behind, single cells go on. m1b_waste_1 is capped and m1b_buffer_in_1 is vented as the drain; m1b_to_module2_1 stays capped.
Count: with every port capped and the flow stopped, the QC window reads the cell concentration and viability.

Resuspend in dextran buffer fed at m1b_buffer_in_1 (off-chip selector valve on dextran buffer) at the dilution that gives about 0.1 cells per capsule in Module 2; the operator sets it from the count. m1b_to_module2_1 stays capped.
Cells out through m1b_to_module2_1 to Module 2's core inlet (m2_core_in_1), once the safety checker approves them; m1b_buffer_in_1 pushes them.
